description:
This video let you understand  the process of Checking your  Mediclaim status , Policy no  ,how to download Reimbursement claim form , Search  Network hospitals ,GMC amount etc  of Good health insurance TPA  LTD earlier known as GHPL 


In the given process you  have to just login with your GHPL Id provided in  your Salary slip and default password as 1234 , if you don't have GHPL id  mentioned in your salary slip please contact your HR or concerned person to avail the same .


Cashless claim process  - 

You have to just approach that hospital where you want to avail the cashless service as per network hospital search ,ask them to enroll patient under cashless facility do that they can send pre-authorization request to Good Health insurance  TPA Ltd .

Provide hospital's  TPA department the complete details and documents what they required to process your cashless claim .

When hospital get the approval from  GHTP LTD they start your treatment .


Reimbursement claim process - Collect all the hospital documents in original like discharge summary, hospital bill , cash paid receipt , medicine prescription & bill , doctor suggested test / investigation report & bill ,  patient id proof , insured person's  cancel cheque , filled claim form .

Courier all these documents to your organization directly as per suggestion of your HR or sent to GHTP LTD  corporate office .

Post recieving your documents GHPL process your claim within 45 working days ( weekly off don't counts ) 

Note - whenever your send any documents to Your organisation or GHPL don't forget to mention your Name , Ecode and Mobile no over the envelope ( If policy is individual policy then you can write what  GHPL suggest  you over the call ) ...
